d: An athletic build wearing a full-body tactical suit in a grey and white urban camouflage pattern, accented by black armor plating, a black chest rig, and red straps. The head is fully enclosed in a black spherical helmet featuring a dark visor with glowing red X-shaped eyes and two thick cables connecting the back of the helmet to the collar. A large black assault rifle is held in the hands, with additional gear including blue canisters and a red-accented utility pouch attached to the black tactical belt. No hair, skin, or facial features are visible.
